deliverables.name: Scope and assumptions
acceptance_criteria: Single service; API boundary, roles, persisted records, exclusions, and unresolved choices recorded.

deliverables.name: API and security design
acceptance_criteria: Define operations, authorization decisions, data ownership, and persistence behavior without presuming database/token/gateway/deployment.

deliverables.name: Service implementation plan
acceptance_criteria: Implement scoped endpoints and role checks with reviewable changes; no execution asserted.

deliverables.name: Verification plan and evidence
acceptance_criteria: Author tests for allowed/denied roles, persistence behavior and HTTP responses; record actual runs before any pass claim.

deliverables.name: Release readiness evidence
acceptance_criteria: Verify candidate, CI/test execution, approval and recovery evidence before release; all remain incomplete.
